subject: Q4 demo window — NeonTech redirects work to internal roadmap
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@neontech.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@neontech.io>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo slot booked for Oct 7 - quick update

Hi Vanessa / Vanessa team,

Quick update from our side — during yesterday's planning sync the execs pulled forward a Q4 feature cadence that consumes the engineering bandwidth we'd earmarked for the LLM pilot. We're redirecting that sprint to a customer-facing feature, so the inference evaluation will need to move off our immediate roadmap.

Can we pause the Oct 7 demo for now? I've attached a short note from our PMs that explains the shift and timelines. We still want to revisit this after our FY Q4 planning (likely early December); would appreciate being put on a check-in cadence rather than continuing with a full technical deep-dive this week.

Apologies for the late notice — this was decided today. Priya and I can share any context you need to preserve the eval work.

Thanks,
Samir Kapoor
VP Product, NeonTech

Attachment: NeonTech-Q4-Roadmap-Notes.pdf (PDF)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@neontech.io>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@neontech.io>
Date: 2026-10-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo slot booked for Oct 7 - quick update

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the roadmap note. Totally understand org shifts like this.

We can absolutely pause the full demo on Oct 7. Two options that might keep momentum with minimal lift:
- Short 20–30 min "snapshot" that walks through cost/latency numbers and expected integration effort (no engineering prep).
- Put you on a 6-week check-in cadence and reopen the demo when you say the runway is available.

If you'd rather fully park the effort, we can mark the HubSpot opportunity as paused and set a tentative follow-up for the first week of December. Would you prefer a check-in or a parked status? If parked, are you comfortable with us retaining the technical notes we've already prepared (architecture sketch, sample prompts) for internal reference? We won't run any tests or store customer data without explicit sign-off.

If helpful I can share a slimmed-down one-pager and a short self-serve eval link so your PM/engineering team can glance at performance without a scheduled meeting.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Samir — copying in a few resources that tend to help teams who are reshuffling priorities but still want to preserve the option to re-engage quickly:

- Lightweight eval kit (self-serve): link I'll drop in follow-up (no infra changes required).
- Short summary of what we'd need to re-initiate a pilot (team ownership, guardrails, target dataset size).

We can also export the architecture sketch Vanessa mentioned and keep it attached to the HubSpot record if you approve — that way your PMs won't need to re-describe current constraints when you re-open. We will not retain or run any samples that include customer data without your explicit consent.

If useful, I can schedule a 15-minute "pause checkpoint" for early December now and mark it as tentative on both calendars; it doesn't have to be a demo, just a quick alignment call so we don't lose context.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks for raising this, Vanessa — looping in as well. Samir, appreciate the transparency. These roadmap-driven pauses are common; two quick thoughts from our side: 

1) If NeonTech is open to it, we can offer a small, time-limited credit (two weeks of hosted eval) to make it easier to pick back up when your window opens — no engineering lift required.
2) If you prefer to park the opportunity, we'll set the HubSpot deal to "paused" and add a tentative follow-up for the first business week of December. If you can share the decision criteria that would trigger re-prioritization (e.g., headcount freed, specific feature delivery), that will help our SDR/AE team re-engage at the right moment.

Vanessa / Monica — please set the HubSpot status to paused and add the NeonTech-Q4-Roadmap-Notes.pdf to the record per Samir's attachment. Also create a tentative 15-minute check-in in early December as Monica suggested (label: "NeonTech: Q4 pause checkpoint").

Samir — we'll hold off on any technical testing and will not store sample data. When you're ready, ping us and we'll prioritize a short proof-of-value path that minimizes ramp.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
